summary: All three formal acceptance criteria for ST-001 are met: packages/ is deleted, zero actual import statements reference package:nextone_core or package:models anywhere in lib/, and pubspec.yaml no longer carries path dependencies on nextone_core or models. auto_mappr and flutter_hooks are correctly retained. Four structural deviations from the ARCHITECTURE.md target tree were introduced and must be remediated — none block ST-002 or ST-003, but all must be corrected before ST-008 closes.

issues.description: lib/nextone.dart umbrella export file was created but is not listed in the ARCHITECTURE.md target lib/ tree. It was added as a workaround for circular self-export issues and exports application_export, injection_export, models.dart, repositories_export, and services_exports. While pragmatically reasonable, it is an undocumented addition that downstream subtasks must be aware of.
issues.evidence: lib/nextone.dart exists on disk; not present in ARCHITECTURE.md Section 2 directory tree.

issues.description: DTO artist subfolder was not renamed. ARCHITECTURE.md migration table (Section 6) specifies the target path as data/models/dto/artist/artist_dto.dart. The actual path on disk is data/models/dto/artist_dto/artist_dto.dart — the legacy artist_dto/ subfolder name was preserved.

Repository implementations and interfaces retained per-entity sub-subfolders from the original package structure. ARCHITECTURE.md specifies flat files: data/repositories/implementations/artist_repository.dart, data/repositories/implementations/user_repository.dart, data/repositories/implementations/ai_content_service.dart, data/repositories/interfaces/i_artist_repository.dart, data/repositories/interfaces/i_user_repository.dart, data/repositories/interfaces/i_ai_content_service.dart. Actual disk layout nests each under an extra named subdirectory (e.g. implementations/artist_repository/artist_repository.dart).

Service interfaces retained per-domain sub-subfolders. ARCHITECTURE.md specifies flat files: data/services/interfaces/i_auth_service.dart and data/services/interfaces/i_audio_service.dart. Actual disk paths are data/services/interfaces/auth/i_auth_service.dart and data/services/interfaces/audio/i_audio_service.dart.

fix_instructions.action: Document lib/nextone.dart in ARCHITECTURE.md Section 2 as an explicitly sanctioned umbrella export barrel, OR remove it and migrate all callers that use package:nextone/ umbrella imports to direct package:nextone/<layer>/... paths. Whichever approach is chosen, resolve before ST-008.
